conditions.en_preparation: The full terms are being drafted. Here is what is settled in the meantime.
conditions.serveur: Hollow is a non-profit community game server running on nanos.world. Access and in-game rules are handled on the server's Discord, which takes precedence.
conditions.marques: Black Clover is a work by Yūki Tabata, published by Shueisha and adapted by Studio Pierrot. Hollow is a fan project, affiliated with none of them, and uses none of their artwork. The illustrations and text on this site are original.

confidentialite.aucun_cookie: This site sets no cookies. The language shown is decided by the page address, not by an identifier stored in your browser.
confidentialite.aucune_collecte: No forms, no accounts, no analytics: the site collects no personal data.
confidentialite.tiers: The only resources loaded come from this domain. Links to Discord open a third-party service, governed by its own privacy policy.

introuvable.explication: The link may be stale, or the page has not been written yet.
